dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing of the 2D profile from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white to high-intensity light grey, exhibiting significant specular reflectance and surface noise.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low frequency; diffuse, low-contrast grey shading localized along the lateral flanks and dorsal midline.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; gradual gradient transitions between the primary light skin tone and darker shaded areas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Distinct vertical, dark-pigmented linear mark positioned along the central dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical dark scar along the midline; faint, low-contrast diagonal linear striations across the mid-dorsal surface.
